people.bio: I am a current master’s student at UCLA and completed my bachelor’s degree at the National Institute of Technology Karnataka. My research interests include exploring high-k dielectric materials for memory-storage applications, as well as technologies related to semiconductor manufacturing and optimization. Beyond the lab, I enjoy watching Formula One, playing squash, driving go-karts, and exploring new cuisines.
